articles.title: Vincent Ingersoll, 89, School Cook
articles.deck: Friends remember Vincent Ingersoll for the many years of service to Lower Millrace.
body: Vincent Ingersoll died in February at home on Quincy Place, at the age of 89. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Lower Millrace.

Born in Lower Millrace in the years after the war, Vincent Ingersoll spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Canal Park Food Pantry in his or her name.
